description: Call in the seconds BEFORE you tell the person something or propose a course of action: returns what is already decided (the project's and this person's own) AND THEN A MAP of the titles and handles of everything else. arroway_read include GUARANTEES a mapped one in full; it does not make that read any cheaper, so use it to be sure, never to pay less. Before publishing text for others, pass it as draft: what it touches comes back in full.

draft.description: Optional: the text you will publish or say (PR, comment, message, page), ending with one line in the project's language on what it claims, recommends and names.

project.description: Project slug the claim is about.

since.description: Optional: checkpoint from a previous arroway_norms call for THIS project (not the read's). Omit after compaction or in a new conversation.

name: arroway_norms
title: What the team already decided, and a map of what else it knows
